1.content:
# AppID Tag Coverage
How much of the monitored estate carries the `AppID` tag (Smartscape entity tags) or attribute (logs, spans). The tag key can be `AppID` or `application_id`. Scope: HOST, SERVICE, PROCESS, K8S_CLUSTER/NAMESPACE/DEPLOYMENT/STATEFULSET/DAEMONSET/CRONJOB, FRONTEND, BROWSER_MONITOR.

Use the **AppID** selector above to filter the Tagged entities, Distinct AppIDs, Entities per AppID and Log volume tiles. Coverage tiles always show the whole estate.

2.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id])
| summarize total = count(), tagged = countIf(isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != "")
| fieldsAdd coverage_pct = round(tagged * 100.0 / total, decimals:1)
| fields coverage_pct
2.title: Entity coverage %

3.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id])
| filter in(AppID, array($AppID))
| summarize tagged = countIf(isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != "")
3.title: Tagged entities

4.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id])
| summarize untagged = countIf(isNull(AppID) or AppID == "")
4.title: Untagged entities

5.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id])
| filter isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != ""
| filter in(AppID, array($AppID))
| summarize distinct_AppIDs = countDistinct(AppID)
5.title: Distinct AppID values

6.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id])
| summarize {total = count(), tagged = countIf(isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != "")}, by:{type}
| fieldsAdd coverage_pct = round(tagged * 100.0 / total, decimals:1)
| fields type, coverage_pct
| sort coverage_pct asc
6.title: Coverage % by entity type

7.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id])
| summarize {total = count(), tagged = countIf(isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != "")}, by:{type}
| fieldsAdd untagged = total - tagged, coverage_pct = round(tagged * 100.0 / total, decimals:1)
| sort coverage_pct asc
7.title: Tagged vs untagged by entity type

8.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id])
| filter isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != ""
| filter in(AppID, array($AppID))
| summarize entities = count(), by:{AppID, type}
| sort entities desc
8.title: Entities per AppID

9.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id])
| filter isNull(AppID) or AppID == ""
| fields type, name, id
| sort type asc, name asc
| limit 500
9.title: Gap list: untagged hosts, services and workloads

10.query:
fetch logs
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(AppID, application_id)
| summarize {total = count(), tagged = countIf(isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != "")}
| fieldsAdd coverage_pct = round(tagged * 100.0 / total, decimals:1)
| fields coverage_pct
10.title: Logs with AppID attribute

11.query:
fetch spans, samplingRatio:100
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(AppID, application_id)
| summarize {total = count(), tagged = countIf(isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != "")}
| fieldsAdd coverage_pct = round(tagged * 100.0 / total, decimals:1)
| fields coverage_pct
11.title: Spans with AppID attribute (sampled)

12.query:
fetch logs
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(AppID, application_id, "(untagged)")
| filter in(AppID, array($AppID))
| makeTimeseries logs = count(), by:{AppID}, interval:15m
12.title: Log volume by AppID

13.title: Coverage by AppID and entity type

14.query:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| filter isNotNull(id_classic)
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id], `tags:AppID`[AppID], `tags:application_id`[application_id], "(untagged)")
| filter in(AppID, array($AppID))
| fields type, name, id_classic, AppID
| sort type asc, name asc
| limit 1000
14.title: Classic entities and their AppID / application_id

variables.input:
smartscapeNodes "HOST","SERVICE","PROCESS","K8S_CLUSTER","K8S_NAMESPACE","K8S_DEPLOYMENT","K8S_STATEFULSET","K8S_DAEMONSET","K8S_CRONJOB","FRONTEND","BROWSER_MONITOR"
| fieldsAdd AppID = coalesce(tags[AppID], tags[application_id], `tags:AppID`[AppID], `tags:application_id`[application_id])
| filter isNotNull(AppID) and AppID != ""
| dedup AppID
| fields AppID
| append [data record(AppID = "(untagged)")]
| sort AppID asc
variables.name: AppID
